property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner and any non-zero newOwner address, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) updates C.owner() to equal the provided newOwner; the mutant instead sets owner to address(0) and thus violates this when newOwner != address(0).
change_summary: Replace the assignment to owner with assigning the zero address, so transferOwnership always sets owner to address(0).
